copy_to_model_parallel_region: copy a tensor into the model parallel region with all-reduce on backward pass
reduce_from_model_parallel_region: all-reduce a tensor from the model parallel region across GPUs in the forward pass
scatter_to_model_parallel_region: scatter a tensor across model parallel GPUs by splitting along the last dimension
gather_from_model_parallel_region: gather and concatenate tensors from model parallel GPUs along the last dimension
review_mappings_module: review the model parallel mappings module for tensor split gather and reduce operations
